approval_body: Muftiate (highest religious body of Lithuanian Sunni Muslims) 'approved' the revised 2010 edition
notes: First Lithuanian Quran (2008, 1,000 copies) — poetic translation by writer/politician Sigitas Geda; called 'scandalous' by GloQur (literalism debates). Revised 2010 w/ Romas Jakubauskas as second translator + Muftiate approval; several reprints.
